passages.provision_quote: SEC. 7.5. (a) The right to marry is a fundamental right. (b) This section is in furtherance of both of the following: (1) The inalienable rights to enjoy life and liberty and to pursue and obtain safety, happiness, and privacy guaranteed by Section 1. (2) The rights to due process and equal protection guaranteed by Section 7.
passages.note: Chaptered ACA 5 text repeals the opposite-sex-only marriage clause and makes marriage a fundamental right with no religious-organization carve-out.

rows.reasoning: Wiener voted Aye on the Senate Floor for ACA 5 (07/13/23), a single-subject constitutional amendment; the chaptered text makes 'the right to marry... a fundamental right' for all couples without reserving marriage for opposite-sex couples or adding a religious-organization exemption, matching rung 2's 'the same benefits and protections as any other marriage' rather than rung 1's added job/housing discrimination clause or rung 3's religious carve-out.
